# ClaudeMC v1.20.0 — Minecraft 1.21.11 support

Major release. ClaudeMC has been migrated from Minecraft 1.21.1 to **1.21.11**,
covering every breaking API change across the 1.21.2 → 1.21.11 line. The mod
compiles, builds, and all mixins apply cleanly at runtime.

> Staying on 1.21.1? Use **v1.19.3**, the last 1.21.1-compatible build.

## Toolchain

| | |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 1.21.11 |
| Yarn | 1.21.11+build.6 |
| Fabric Loader | 0.19.3 |
| Fabric API | 0.141.4+1.21.11 |
| fabric-loom | 1.13.4 |
| Gradle | 8.14 |
| Java | 21 |

## API migrations

- **Input refactor** — the new `Click` / `KeyInput` / `CharInput` records replace
  the old primitive `mouseClicked` / `keyPressed` / `charTyped` parameters. Every
  ClickGUI and screen input handler was rewritten, and `ScreenMixin.keyPressed`
  updated to the `KeyInput` signature.
- **Movement** — the immutable `PlayerInput` record replaces the mutable
  `movementForward` / `movementSideways` / `jumping` / `sneaking` fields;
  `KeyboardInputMixin` rebuilt (`tick()` now takes no arguments) for InventoryMove
  and AutoMine.
- **Rendering (1.21.5 pipeline)** — `RenderLayer.LINES` → `RenderLayers.LINES`;
  the removed `WorldRenderer.drawBox` is replaced by manual twelve-edge box
  rendering in `RenderUtils`.
- **Render-state camera (1.21.9)** — `WorldRenderEvents` moved to the `.world`
  subpackage; camera position now read from `ctx.worldState().cameraRenderState.pos`;
  `matrixStack()` → `matrices()`.
- **Inventory** — `PlayerInventory.selectedSlot` →
  `getSelectedSlot()` / `setSelectedSlot()`; `getArmorStack` → `getEquippedStack`.
- **Entity** — `getPos()` → `getEntityPos()`; `isFallFlying()` → `isGliding()`.
- **Misc** — `Direction.getName()` → `asString()`; `World.getTopY()` →
  `getTopYInclusive()`; `World.setTimeOfDay()` → `setTime(time, timeOfDay, false)`.
- **Armor** — the removed `ArmorItem` class gives way to the `EquippableComponent`
  and the `ARMOR` attribute (AutoArmor); the HUD reads armor via equipment slots.
- **Profiles/session** — `GameProfile` is now a record (`getName()`/`getId()` →
  `name()`/`id()`); the `Session` constructor no longer takes an `AccountType`.
- **Input util** — `InputUtil.isKeyPressed` now takes a `Window`; key polling
  queries GLFW directly by window handle.

All existing modules and the Companion web app are carried forward unchanged in
behaviour.
